name: hollow-ridge
description: Hollow Ridge - browser FPS with LAN multiplayer. No npm dependencies (three.js r169 is bundled in vendor/).

scripts.bake: node tools/bake-textures.mjs && node tools/bake-terrain.mjs && node build.mjs --check
scripts.test:parity: node test/tex-parity.mjs && node test/terrain-parity.mjs && node test/grass-window.mjs
